sourceReview.reason: The accessible Coinfomania page is an AI-generated summary of a Fireblocks social post and provides generic market commentary rather than a verifiable new event. It names no new pilot, participant commitment, transaction, launch date or primary document, so the social-post derivative is not an acceptable source for an RWA Wire article.
